explanation.value: For a single mode every charged step has the same time and the same cost, so the best route for that mode is simply the one with the fewest steps. Run a BFS from S that only enters cells of that mode's digit and stops when it reaches D. If D is found after s moves, s - 1 of them left a mode cell, so the totals are (s - 1) * time and (s - 1) * cost. Compare the (time, cost, index) triples over all modes and return the best name.
